items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Elvis Presley watching Ike Turner play piano: 'there was an alley in this place where Ike was playing... Elvis then could peer in and watch him play the piano.' The interviewee (Chuck Mancuso) is reporting what Jerry Lieber/Elvis knew, not describing a personal
